original:
केनेषितं पतति प्रेषितं मनः। केन प्राणः प्रथमः प्रैति युक्तः।
केनेषितां वाचमिमां वदन्ति। चक्षुः श्रोत्रं क उ देवो युनक्ति॥
transliteration:
keneṣitaṃ patati preṣitaṃ manaḥ | kena prāṇaḥ prathamaḥ praiti yuktaḥ |
keneṣitāṃ vācamimāṃ vadanti | cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ka u devo yunakti ||

layers.author: siva
layers.content: By whom willed and directed does the mind light upon its objects? Commanded by whom does the main Prana (breath) proceed to function? By whose will do men utter speech? What intelligence directs the eyes and the ears?
